Rule: Genetic-Behavioral, Genetic-Environmental, and Behavioral-Environmental pairs should have controlled and comparable representation.
ASD and NON-ASD semantic relationships should be controlled to prevent majority-class dominance.
Positive same-class and negative different-class relationships should be explicitly controlled.
All randomized pair generation must use fixed random seeds.
Do not generate every possible cross-product pair.
Pair indices must never be interpreted as patient identity correspondence.
Every generated pair must retain modality, class, relationship type, and source index metadata.
